newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Avtobank to issue $25 mln of Euronotes. [CORRECTED 00:40 GMT 29/11]
newsitem.headline: Russia's Avtobank to issue $25 mln of Euronotes. [CORRECTED 00:40 GMT 29/11]

text.p: AKB Avtobank plans to issue $25 million worth of six-month Euronotes in December 1996, a bank spokesman said on Wednesday.
The bond, placed through the CEDEL and Euroclear systems by Moscow Narodny Bank and HSBC Markets company, will have an annualised yield of LIBOR plus 5.5 percent, Nikolai Popov told Reuters.
The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development is buying an eight percent stake in Avtobank at about $3,000 per share with a face value of $1,000, he said.

But following this transaction the bank's capital will be redenominated as 572.5 billion roubles, divided into shares with a face value of 100 roubles, instead of $60 million and three billion roubles, he said.
(Corrects bank's authorised capital in accordance with a new figure issued by Avtobank).
The EBRD will also grant Avtobank a $30 million credit, he said.
